data_snapshots_deletion_state_valid.name: data_snapshots_deletion_state_valid
data_snapshots_deletion_state_valid.value:
(
        "data_snapshots"."deletion_status" is null
        and "data_snapshots"."deletion_requested_at" is null
        and "data_snapshots"."deletion_failure_reason" is null
        and "data_snapshots"."deletion_lease_id" is null
        and "data_snapshots"."deletion_lease_expires_at" is null
      ) or (
        "data_snapshots"."deletion_status" = 'deleting'
        and "data_snapshots"."deletion_requested_at" is not null
        and "data_snapshots"."deletion_failure_reason" is null
        and "data_snapshots"."deletion_lease_id" is not null
        and "data_snapshots"."deletion_lease_expires_at" is not null
      ) or (
        "data_snapshots"."deletion_status" = 'delete_failed'
        and "data_snapshots"."deletion_requested_at" is not null
        and "data_snapshots"."deletion_failure_reason" is not null
        and "data_snapshots"."deletion_lease_id" is null
        and "data_snapshots"."deletion_lease_expires_at" is null
      )

data_snapshots_retention_protection.name: data_snapshots_retention_protection
data_snapshots_retention_protection.value:
("data_snapshots"."snapshot_kind" = 'automatic' or "data_snapshots"."deletion_status" is null)
        and (not "data_snapshots"."pinned" or "data_snapshots"."deletion_status" is null)

exercise_media_associations_target_check.name: exercise_media_associations_target_check
exercise_media_associations_target_check.value:
(
        "exercise_media_associations"."match_scope" = 'exact_variant'
        AND "exercise_media_associations"."exercise_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "exercise_media_associations"."family_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "exercise_media_associations"."match_scope" = 'equivalent_family'
        AND "exercise_media_associations"."exercise_id" IS NULL
        AND "exercise_media_associations"."family_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND jsonb_array_length("exercise_media_associations"."equipment_signature") > 0
      )
